slides.title: Tell me you manage a restaurant in December without telling me.
Six holiday parties booked. Two new servers still need their food handler cards.
slides.body: The class is "next week." It's been next week for a while.

slides.title: The health permit is framed by the host stand.
slides.body: Nobody has read the date on it since the day it went up.

slides.title: The liquor license renewal notice is in the office.
slides.body: Under the produce invoices. Under the other produce invoices.

slides.title: The hood system inspection tag says a month that already happened.
slides.body: The New Year's Eve menu is printed, though.

slides.title: Save this. Check all four dates before the first party.
slides.body: Which one is on your wall right now?
